summary: Destination validation belongs on the create path. UrlValidator already performs syntactic checks (scheme, host, length, self-reference) and is shared by LinkService.create. Safety is a separate concern with its own configuration, so a new DestinationSafetyPolicy invoked from LinkService.create after syntactic validation keeps UrlValidator focused and its tests unchanged. Configuration lives under shortener.* in application.yml; a separate SafetyProperties record avoids changing the existing ShortenerProperties constructor that tests build directly. GlobalExceptionHandler maps domain exceptions to problem types.

impactedFiles.reason: Typed configuration for the blocklist and IP-literal rule

dataFlows: Create: LinkController -> LinkService.create -> UrlValidator.validate (syntax) -> DestinationSafetyPolicy.check (safety) -> insert, or UnsafeDestinationException -> 422
architecturalNotes: Redirect path is untouched, so redirect latency is unaffected
TestProperties builds ShortenerProperties directly; adding a component to that record would break existing tests
Exception messages must not echo the submitted URL, which may contain credentials
